About Lomas Verdes Estates

North Poway's quiet estate enclave

Lomas Verdes Estates sits in the hills of North Poway, off Valle Verde and Old Winery Road. Most homes were built in the mid-1980s and early '90s on lots of around one acre, many of them single-level with pools, mature landscaping and room to spread out.

Elevated lots give many homes panoramic views across the golf course, the historic Old Winery and the Lake Hodges basin. Some homes sit behind private gates.

The Lomas Verdes Estates HOA keeps dues modest, around $460–$525 a year in recent listings, which is rare at this price point.

Living here

Why people choose Lomas Verdes Estates

Wine country next door

Some homes are within walking distance of Bernardo Winery, the region's historic winery, with its shops and cafés.

Golf & resort living

Championship golf and dining at the Rancho Bernardo Inn are minutes away.

Trails & lakes

Lake Poway and an extensive network of hiking and biking trails are close by for weekend mornings.

Poway Unified schools

The neighborhood is served by the highly regarded Poway Unified School District, with Chaparral Elementary close by.

Good to know

Lomas Verdes Estates FAQ

Where is Lomas Verdes Estates?

Lomas Verdes Estates is in North Poway (92064), in the hills off Valle Verde Road and Old Winery Road, near Bernardo Winery and Rancho Bernardo.

Does Lomas Verdes Estates have an HOA?

Yes. The Lomas Verdes Estates HOA has modest annual dues, about $460–$525 per year in recent listings. Confirm the current amount for a specific home with Lara.

What schools serve Lomas Verdes Estates?

Homes here are in Poway Unified School District. Chaparral Elementary is close by, and many listings note Poway High. Always confirm the assigned schools for a specific address with the district.

How big are the lots and homes?

Most lots are around one acre, and homes typically range from about 3,000 to 6,500 square feet, with three to five bedrooms. Many are single-level.

How much do homes in Lomas Verdes Estates cost?

Recent sales and listings have mostly ranged from about $2.25M to $2.9M, depending on size, updates, views and lot. Ask Lara for a current report.
